Four test files reach `findEnclosingSgSymbols`. Each one imports it from `../src/sg.js` and calls it directly:

- `tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts` is also the only test that reaches it through the sg tool. In `src/sg.ts:415` the tool calls it only when `PI_CONTEXT_HYGIENE_DEBUG=1`, and this file sets that variable while registering the tool with `registerSgTool`.
- `tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts`
- `tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts`
- `tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts`

`tests/context-hygiene-debug-tool.test.ts` also sets that variable, but it never uses the sg tool, so it doesn't call the function.
